tagline: Near-black canvas with a faint square grid, square-cornered panels outlined in cyan and violet, gradient headlines and a syntax-coloured code block.

palette.description: deep black, dark indigo panels, fluorescent cyan primary and tech violet secondary

typography.style: system grotesque headlines with JetBrains Mono for labels and code

best_for: Developer and product-demo decks that include code or pseudo-code. Cyan marks the primary signal, violet the secondary.
avoid_for: Warm, human or print-first material; neon outlines do not survive greyscale.
name: Tech Dark Grid
